'''Vellas Pavo''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Before and during the [[Republic Dark Age]] the world was a known source of [[gadolinium]].

==History==
Before<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> and during<ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> the [[Republic Dark Age]], the element [[gadolinium]], an important element used in the manufacture of superconductors,<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> was mined on Vellas Pavo by one of the four largest superconductor manufacturer companies in the Grumani sector.<ref name="Knight Errant" />

At some point between [[1066 BBY]]<ref name="Knight Errant novel">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']], [[1066 BBY]] is given as the date in which the ''[[Charge Matrica]]'' began, and Chagras is mentioned to have established his realm at the conclusion of this event</ref> and [[1040 BBY]], the planet was under the [[Chagras Hegemony|control]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Chagras]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" />

After Chagras' [[Death/Legends|death]] in 1040 BBY, the planet was located near the borders of [[Daiman]]'s [[Daimanate|realm]],<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer" /> however, no Sith Lord ruled over the planet in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].<ref name="Knight Errant" />

Shortly after the [[Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility]] was [[Mission to Darkknell (New Sith Wars)|destroyed]] on [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] in 1032 BBY, the Sith Lord [[Ayanos Bactra]] made a deal with Daiman. Bactra, who controlled the other three superconductor interests, offered him an [[arxeum]] built by the [[Industrial Heuristics]] in exchange for passage across Daimanate territory in order to strike at the mining operations on Vellas Pavo and to eliminate Bactra's remaining competitor. Daiman agreed, however during the following [[Battle of Gazzari|battle]] on the planet [[Gazzari]] he and his brother [[Odion]] joined their forces and turned on Bactra, taking him by surprise and proceeding to [[Battle of Jutrand|topple]] his [[Bactranate|realm]].<ref name="Knight Errant" /> Later the planet fell into the hands of Lord Daiman.<ref name="Deluge 2" />
